transliteration: Qaaloo Subhaanaka maa kaana yambaghee lanaaa an nattakhiza min doonika min awliyaaa'a wa laakim matta'tahum wa aabaaa'ahum hattaa nasuz zikra wa kaanoo qawmam booraa

arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًۭا وَلَا نَصْرًۭا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
transliteration: Faqad kazzabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa tastatee'oona sarfanw wa laa nasraa; wa mai yazlim minkum nuziqhu 'azaaban kabeeraa

arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًۭا
translation: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
transliteration: Wa maaa arsalnaa qablaka minal mursaleena illaaa innahum la yaakuloonat ta'aama wa yamshoona fil aswaaq; wa ja'alnaa ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan atasbiroon; wa kaana Rabbuka Baseera

arabic: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
transliteration: Wa qaalal lazeena laa yarjoona liqaaa'anaa law laaa unzila 'alainal malaaa'ikatu awnaraa Rabbanaa; laqadistakbaroo feee anfusihim wa 'ataw 'utuwwan kabeeraa

arabic: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
translation: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
transliteration: Yawma yarawnal malaaa 'ikata laa bushraa Yawma'izil lilmujrimeena wa yaqooloona hijram mahjooraa

arabic: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍۢ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هَبَآءًۭ مَّنثُورًا
translation: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
transliteration: Wa qadimnaaa ilaa maa 'amiloo min 'amalin faja'alnaahu habaaa'am mansooraa

arabic: أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌۭ مُّسْتَقَرًّۭا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًۭا
translation: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
transliteration: As haabul jannati yawma'izin khairum mustaqar ranw wa ahsanu maqeela

arabic: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
translation: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
transliteration: Wa Yawma tashaqqaqus samaaa'u bilghamaami wa nuzzilal malaaa'ikatu tanzeela

arabic: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًۭا
translation: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
transliteration: Almulku Yawma'izinil haqqu lir Rahmaan; wa kaana Yawman'alal kaafireena 'aseeraa

arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًۭا
translation: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
transliteration: Wa Yawma ya'adduz zaalimu 'alaa yadaihi yaqoolu yaa laitanit takhaztu ma'ar Rasooli sabeelaa

arabic: يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًۭا
translation: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
transliteration: Yaa wailataa laitanee lam attakhiz fulaanan khaleelaa

arabic: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولًۭا
translation: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
transliteration: Laqad adallanee 'aniz zikri ba'da iz jaaa'anee; wa kaanash Shaitaanu lil insaani khazoolaa

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًۭا
translation: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."
transliteration: Wa qaalar Rasoolu yaa Rabbi inna qawmit takhazoo haazal Qur-aana mahjooraa

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًۭا وَنَصِيرًۭا
translation: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
transliteration: Wa kazaalika ja'alnaa likulli Nabiyyin 'aduwwam minal mujrimeen; wa kafaa bi Rabbika haadiyanw wa naseeraa

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَٰهُ تَرْتِيلًۭا
translation: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
transliteration: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo law laa nuzzila 'alaihil Quraanu jumlatanw waahidah; kazaalika linusabbita bihee fu'aadaka wa rattalnaahu tarteelaa

arabic: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
translation: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
transliteration: Wa laa yaatoonaka bimasainn illaa ji'naaka bilhaqqi wa ahsana tafseeraa

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا
translation: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
transliteration: Allazeena yuhsharoona 'alaa wujoohim ilaa jahannama ulaaa'ika sharrum makaananw wa adallu sabeelaa )section 3)

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba wa ja'alnaa ma'ahooo akhaahu Haaroona wazeeraa

arabic: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًۭا
translation: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
transliteration: Faqulnaz habaaa ilal qawmil lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa fadammarnaahum tadmeeraa

arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
translation: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
transliteration: Wa qawma Noohil lammaa kazzabur Rusula aghraqnaahum wa ja'alnaahum linnaasi Aayatanw wa a'tadnaa lizzaalimeena 'azaaban aleemaa

arabic: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًۭا
translation: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
transliteration: Wa 'Aadanw Samooda wa As haabar Rassi wa quroonam baina zaalika kaseeraa

arabic: وَكُلًّۭا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًۭا
translation: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
transliteration: Wa kullandarabnaa lahul amsaala wa kullan tabbarnaa tatbeera

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًۭا
translation: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
transliteration: Wa laqad ataw 'alal qaryatil lateee umtirat mataras saw'; afalam yakoonoo yarawnahaa; bal kaanoo laa yarjoona nushooraa

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
translation: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
transliteration: Wa izaa ra awka iny yattakhizoonaka illaa huzuwan ahaazal lazee ba'asal laahu Rasoolaa

arabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
translation: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
transliteration: In kaada la yudillunaa 'an aalihatinaa law laaa an sabarnaa 'alaihaa; wa sawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawnal 'azaaba man adallu sabeela

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
translation: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
transliteration: Ara'aita manit takhaza ilaahahoo hawaahu afa anta takoonu 'alaihi wakeelaa

arabic: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
translation: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
transliteration: Am tahsabu annna aksarahum yasma'oona aw ya''qiloon; in hum illaa kal an'aami bal hum adallu sabeelan

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًۭا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًۭا
translation: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
transliteration: Alam tara ilaa Rabbika kaifa maddaz zilla wa law shaaa'a laja'alahoo saakinan summa ja'alnash shamsa 'alaihe daleelaa

arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
translation: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
transliteration: Summa qabadnaahu ilainaa qabdany yaseeraa

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًۭا
translation: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul laila libaasanw wannawma subaatanw wa ja'alan nahaara nushooraa

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ طَهُورًۭا
translation: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazeee arsalar riyaaha bushram baina yadai rahmatih; wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an tahooraa

arabic: لِّنُحْۦِىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًۭا
translation: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
transliteration: Linuhyiya bihee balda tam maitanw wa nusqiyahoo mimmaa khalaqnaaa an'aa manw wa anaasiyya kaseeraa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
translation: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
transliteration: Wa laqad sarrafnaahu bainahum li yazzakkaroo fa abaaa aksarun naasi illaa kufooraa

arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍۢ نَّذِيرًۭا
translation: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
transliteration: Wa law shi'naa laba'asnaa fee kulli qar yatin nazeeraa

arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
translation: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.
transliteration: Falaa tuti'il kaafireena wa jaahidhum bihee jihaadan kabeeraa

arabic: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
translation: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee marajal bahraini haazaa 'azbun furaatunw wa haazaa milhun ujaaj; wa ja'ala bainahumaa barzakhanw wa hijram mahjooraa

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًۭا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًۭا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًۭا
translation: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee khalaqa minal maaa'i basharran fa ja'alahoo nasaban wa sihraa; wa kaana Rabbuka Qadeeraa

arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًۭا
translation: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
transliteration: Wa ya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'uhum wa laa yadurruhum; wa kaanal kaafiru 'alaa Rabbihee zaheeraa

arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
transliteration: Wa maa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiranw wa nazeeraa

arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
translation: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
transliteration: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin illaa man shaaa'a ai yattakhiza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa

arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
transliteration: Wa tawakkal 'alal Haiyil lazee laa yamootu wa sabbih bihamdih; wa kafaa bihee bizunoobi 'ibaadihee khabeeraa

arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًۭا
translation: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
transliteration: Allazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati aiyaamin summmmastawaa 'alal 'Arsh; ar Rahmaanu fas'al bihee khabeeraa

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًۭا ۩
translation: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahumus judoo lir Rahmaani qaaloo wa mar Rahmaanu anasjudu limaa taamurunaa wa zaadahum nufooraa

arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًۭا وَقَمَرًۭا مُّنِيرًۭا
translation: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
transliteration: Tabaarakal lazee ja'ala fis samaaa'i buroojanw wa ja'ala feehaa siraajanw wa qamaram muneeraa

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةًۭ لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًۭا
translation: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
transliteration: Wa huwal lazee ja'alal laila wannahaara khilfatal liman araada ai yazzakkara aw araadaa shookooraa

arabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا
translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
transliteration: Wa 'ibaadur Rahmaanil lazeena yamshoona 'alal ardi hawnanw wa izaa khaata bahumul jaahiloona qaaloo salaamaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًۭا وَقِيَٰمًۭا
translation: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
transliteration: Wallazeena yabeetoona li Rabbihim sujjadanw wa qiyaamaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
transliteration: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanas rif 'annnaa 'azaaba Jahannama inn 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa

arabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
translation: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
transliteration: Innahaa saaa'at mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
translation: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
transliteration: Wallazeena izaaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo wa lam yaqturoo wa kaana baina zaalika qawaamaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا
translation: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
transliteration: Wallazeena laa yad'oona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara wa laa yaqtuloonan nafsal latee harramal laahu illaa bilhaqqi wa laa yaznoon; wa mai yaf'al zaalika yalqa asaamaa

arabic: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
translation: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
transliteration: Yudaa'af lahul 'azaabu Yawmal Qiyaamati wa yakhlud feehee muhaanaa

arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
transliteration: Illaa man taaba wa 'aamana wa 'amila 'amalan saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yubad dilul laahu saiyi aatihim hasanaat; wa kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheemaa

arabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
translation: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
transliteration: Wa man taaba wa 'amila saalihan fa innnahoo yatoobu ilal laahi mataabaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
translation: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
transliteration: Wallazeena laa yash hadoonaz zoora wa izaa marroo billaghwi marroo kiraamaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
translation: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
transliteration: Wallazeena izaa zukkiroo bi Aayaati Rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alaihaa summanw wa'umyaanaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
transliteration: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj 'alnaa lilmuttaqeena Imaamaa

arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا
translation: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
transliteration: Ulaaa'ika yujzawnal ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wa yulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatanw wa salaamaa

arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
translation: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
transliteration: Khaalideena feehaa; hasunat mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa

arabic: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
translation: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
transliteration: Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum Rabbee law laa du'aaa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓمٓ
translation: Ta, Seen, Meem.
transliteration: Taa-Seeen-Meeem

arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation: These are the verses of the clear Book.
transliteration: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen

arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
transliteration: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen

arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
translation: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
transliteration: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
transliteration: Wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen

arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
transliteration: Faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
translation: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
transliteration: Awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Inn fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
transliteration: Wa iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen

arabic: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
translation: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
transliteration: Qawma Fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon

arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
translation: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
transliteration: Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa Haaroon

arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
translation: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
transliteration: Wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon

arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
translation: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
transliteration: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon

arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
transliteration: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
transliteration: An arsil ma'anaa Baneee Israaa'eel

arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
transliteration: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen

arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
transliteration: Wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen

arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
transliteration: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen

arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen

arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
transliteration: Wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel

arabic: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
transliteration: Qaala Fir'awnu wa maa Rabbul 'aalameen

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
transliteration: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen

arabic: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
translation: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
transliteration: Qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
transliteration: Qaala Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
transliteration: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
transliteration: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon

arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
translation: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
transliteration: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen

arabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
transliteration: Qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen

arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
transliteration: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen

arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
transliteration: Fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen

arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
translation: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
transliteration: Wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen

arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
translation: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
transliteration: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem

arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
transliteration: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
translation: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
transliteration: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen

arabic: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
translation: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
transliteration: Yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem

arabic: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
translation: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
transliteration: Fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati Yawmim ma'loom

arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
transliteration: Wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon

arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
translation: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
transliteration: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
translation: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
transliteration: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen

arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
transliteration: Qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen

arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
transliteration: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon

arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
translation: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
transliteration: Fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon

arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
transliteration: Fa alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
transliteration: Fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
transliteration: Qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
translation: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
transliteration: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon

arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
transliteration: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
transliteration: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon

arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
transliteration: Innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen

arabic: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
transliteration: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon

arabic: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
translation: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
transliteration: Fa arsala Fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌۭ قَلِيلُونَ
translation: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
transliteration: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon

arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation: And indeed, they are enraging us,
transliteration: Wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon

arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
translation: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
transliteration: Wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon

arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
translation: So We removed them from gardens and springs
transliteration: Fa akhrajnaahum min Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

arabic: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
translation: And treasures and honorable station -
transliteration: Wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
transliteration: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa Baneee Israaa'eel

arabic: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation: So they pursued them at sunrise.
transliteration: Fa atba'oohum mushriqeen

arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
transliteration: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon

arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
transliteration: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa yahdeen

arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
transliteration: Fa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem

arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
transliteration: Wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen

arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
transliteration: Wa anjainaa Moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een

arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation: Then We drowned the others.
transliteration: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
transliteration: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a Ibraaheem

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon

arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
translation: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
transliteration: Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen

arabic: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
transliteration: Qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon

arabic: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
transliteration: Aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon

arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
transliteration: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon

arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
transliteration: Qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon

arabic: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation: You and your ancient forefathers?
transliteration: Antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon

arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
transliteration: Fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa Rabbal 'aalameen

arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
transliteration: Allazee khalaqanee fa Huwa yahdeen

arabic: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
transliteration: Wallazee Huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen

arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
transliteration: Wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen

arabic: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
transliteration: Wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen

arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
transliteration: Wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee Yawmad Deen

arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen

arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
translation: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
transliteration: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen

arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
transliteration: Waj'alnee minw warasati Jannnatin Na'eem

arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
transliteration: Waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen

arabic: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
transliteration: Wa laa tukhzinee Yawma yub'asoon

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
transliteration: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon

arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
translation: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
transliteration: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem

arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
transliteration: Wa uzlifatil Jannatu lilmuttaqeen

arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
transliteration: Wa burrizatil Jaheemu lilghaaween

arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
transliteration: Wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon

arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
transliteration: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon

arabic: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
transliteration: Fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon

arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
transliteration: Wa junoodu Ibleesa ajma'oon

arabic: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation: They will say while they dispute therein,
transliteration: Qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon

arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
transliteration: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen

arabic: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Iz nusawweekum bi Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
transliteration: Wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon

arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
translation: So now we have no intercessors
transliteration: Famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een

arabic: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ
translation: And not a devoted friend.
transliteration: Wa laa sadeeqin hameem

arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
transliteration: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation: The people of Noah denied the messengers
transliteration: Kazzabat qawmu Noohinil Mursaleen

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon

arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me.
transliteration: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me."
transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

arabic: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
transliteration: Qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon

arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
transliteration: Qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
transliteration: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon

arabic: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
transliteration: Wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen

arabic: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation: I am only a clear warner."
transliteration: In ana illaa nazeerum mubeen

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
transliteration: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon

arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
transliteration: Faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
transliteration: Fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon

arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
transliteration: Summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation: 'Aad denied the messengers
transliteration: Kazzabat 'Aadunil mursaleen

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Hoodun alaa tattaqoon

arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me.
transliteration: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Wa maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةًۭ تَعْبَثُونَ
translation: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
transliteration: Atabnoona bikulli ree'in aayatan ta'basoon

arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
transliteration: Wa tattakhizoona masaani'a la'allakum takhludoon

arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
transliteration: Wa izaa batashtum batashtum jabbaareen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me.
transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
transliteration: Wattaqul lazeee amad dakum bimaa ta'lamoon

arabic: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
translation: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
transliteration: Amaddakum bi an'aa minw wa baneen

arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
translation: And gardens and springs.
transliteration: Wa jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
transliteration: Innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem

arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
transliteration: Qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa 'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen

arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
transliteration: In haazaaa illaa khuluqul awwaleen

arabic: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation: And we are not to be punished."
transliteration: Wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation: Thamud denied the messengers
transliteration: Kazzabat Samoodul mursaleen

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Saalihun alaa tattaqoon

arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me.
transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
transliteration: Atutrakoona fee maa haahunnaaa aamineen

arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
translation: Within gardens and springs
transliteration: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

arabic: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَنَخْلٍۢ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌۭ
translation: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
transliteration: Wa zuroo inw wa nakhlin tal 'uhaa hadeem

arabic: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا فَٰرِهِينَ
translation: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
transliteration: Wa tanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan faariheen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me.
transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

arabic: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
transliteration: Wa laa tutee'ooo amral musrifeen

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
transliteration: Allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
transliteration: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
transliteration: Maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi Aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen

arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
translation: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
transliteration: Qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw w alakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom

arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
transliteration: Wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabu Yawmin 'Azeem

arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَٰدِمِينَ
translation: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
transliteration: Fa'aqaroohaa fa asbahoo naadimeen

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Fa akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum m'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation: The people of Lot denied the messengers
transliteration: kazzabat qawmu Lootinil mursaleen

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Lootun alaa tattaqoon

arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
transliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me.
transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Do you approach males among the worlds
transliteration: Ataatoonaz zukraana minal 'aalameen

arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
translation: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
transliteration: Wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
transliteration: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen

arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
translation: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
transliteration: Qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen

arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
translation: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
transliteration: Rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon

arabic: فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation: So We saved him and his family, all,
transliteration: Fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een

arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
translation: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
transliteration: Illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen

arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
translation: Then We destroyed the others.
transliteration: Summa dammarnal aa khareen

arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
transliteration: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
transliteration: Kazzaba As haabul Aykatil mursaleen

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
transliteration: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon

arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: So fear Allah and obey me.
transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
transliteration: Awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen

arabic: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation: And weigh with an even balance.
transliteration: Wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem

arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
transliteration: Wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen

arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
transliteration: Wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
transliteration: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
transliteration: Wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen

arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
transliteration: Fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
transliteration: Qaala Rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Wa innahoo latanzeelu Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
transliteration: Nazala bihir Roohul Ameen

arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
transliteration: 'Alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen

arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation: In a clear Arabic language.
transliteration: Bilisaanin 'Arabiyyim mubeen

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
transliteration: Wa innahoo lafee Zuburil awwaleen

arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
transliteration: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel

arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
transliteration: Wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen

arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
transliteration: Faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
transliteration: Kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
transliteration: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem

arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
transliteration: Fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

arabic: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
transliteration: Fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon

arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
transliteration: Aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon

arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
transliteration: Aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen

arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
transliteration: Summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
transliteration: Maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon

arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
transliteration: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon

arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
transliteration: Zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen

arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
translation: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
transliteration: Wa maa tanazzalat bihish Shayaateen

arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
transliteration: Wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
transliteration: Innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon

arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
transliteration: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen

arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
transliteration: Wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen

arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
transliteration: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen

arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
transliteration: Fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon

arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
transliteration: Wa tawakkal alal 'Azeezir Raheem

arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation: Who sees you when you arise
transliteration: Allazee yaraaka heena taqoom

arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
translation: And your movement among those who prostrate.
transliteration: Wa taqallubaka fis saajideen

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
transliteration: Innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
transliteration: Hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush Shayaateen

arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
translation: They descend upon every sinful liar.
transliteration: Tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem

arabic: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ
translation: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
transliteration: Yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon

arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
transliteration: Washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
translation: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
transliteration: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon

arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
translation: And that they say what they do not do? -
transliteration: Wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
translation: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
translation: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
transliteration: Taa-Seeen; tilka Aayaatul Qur-aani wa Kitaabim Mubeen

arabic: هُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
transliteration: Hudanw wa bushraa lil mu'mineen

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
translation: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
transliteration: Allazeena yuqeemoonas Salaata wa yu'toonaz Zakaata wa hum bil Aakhirati hum yooqinoon

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
translation: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
transliteration: Innal lazeena laa yu'mimoona bil Aakhirati zaiyannaa lahum a'maalahum fahum ya'mahoon

arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
translation: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena lahum sooo'ul 'azaabi wa hum fil Aakhirati humul akhsaroon

arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.
transliteration: Wa innaka latulaqqal Qur-aana mil ladun Hakeemin 'Aleem

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
translation: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
transliteration: Iz qaala Moosaa li ahliheee inneee aanastu naaran saaateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw aateekum bishihaabin qabasil la'allakum tastaloon

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
transliteration: Falammaa jaaa'ahaa noodiya am boorika man finnnnaari wa man hawlahaa wa Subhaanal laahi Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
translation: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
transliteration: Yaa Moosaaa innahooo Anal laahul 'Azeezul Hakeem

arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًۭا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
transliteration: Wa alqi 'asaak; falammmaa ra aahaa tahtazzu ka annahaa jaaannunw wallaa mudbiranw wa lam yu'aqqib; yaa Moosaa laa takhaf innee laa yakhaafu ladaiyal mursaloon

arabic: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍۢ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
translation: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
transliteration: Illaa man zalama summa baddala husnam ba'da sooo'in fa innee Ghafoorur Raheem

arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
translation: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
transliteration: Wa adkhil yadaka fee jaibika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairisooo'in feetis'i Aayaatin ilaa Fir'awna wa qawmih; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
translation: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
transliteration: Falammaa jaaa'at hum Aayaatunaa mubsiratan qaaloo haazaa sihrum mubeen

arabic: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًۭا وَعُلُوًّۭا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
translation: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
transliteration: Wa jahadoo bihaa wastaiqanat haaa anfusuhum zulmanw-wa 'uluwwaa; fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaa Daawooda wa sulaimaana 'ilmaa; wa qaalal hamdu lil laahil lazee faddalanaa 'alaa kaseerim min 'ibaadihil mu'mineen

arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
transliteration: Wa warisa Sulaimaanu Daawooda wa qaala yaaa aiyuhan naasu 'ullimnaa mantiqat tairi wa ooteenaa min kulli shai'in inna haazaa lahuwal fadlul mubeen

arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
translation: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.
transliteration: Wa hushira Sulaimaana junooduhoo minal jinni wal insi wattairi fahum yooza'oon

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
transliteration: hattaaa izaaa ataw 'alaa waadin namli qaalat namlatuny yaaa aiyuhan namlud khuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaimaanu wa junooduhoo wa hum laa yash'uroon

arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًۭا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
transliteration: Fatabassama daahikam min qawlihaa wa qaala Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mata kal lateee an'amta 'alaiya wa 'alaa waalidaiya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas saaliheen

arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
translation: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
transliteration: Wa tafaqqadat taira faqaala maa liya laaa aral hud hud, am kaana minal ghaaa'ibeen

arabic: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
translation: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
transliteration: La-u'azzibanahoo 'azaaban shadeedan aw la azbahannahoo aw layaatiyannee bisultaanim mubeen

arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍۢ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍۢ يَقِينٍ
translation: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
transliteration: Famakasa ghaira ba'eedin faqaala ahattu bimaa lam tuhit bihee wa ji'tuka min Sabaim binaba iny-yaqeen

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
translation: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
transliteration: Innee wajattum ra atan tamlikuhum wa ootiyat min kulli shai'inw wa lahaa 'arshun 'azeem

arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
translation: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
transliteration: Wajattuhaa wa qawmahaa yasjudoona lishshamsi min doonil laahi wa zaiyana lahumush Shaitaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum 'anis sabeeli fahum laa yahtadoon

arabic: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
translation: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
transliteration: Allaa yasjudoo lillaahil lazee yukhrijul khab'a fis samaawaati wal ardi wa ya'lamu maa tukhfoona wa maa tu'linoon

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩
translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
transliteration: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Azeem

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
translation: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
transliteration: Qaala sananzuru asadaqta am kunta minal kaazibeen

arabic: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
transliteration: Izhab bikitaabee haaza fa alqih ilaihim summma tawalla 'anhum fanzur maazaa yarji'oon

arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
translation: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
transliteration: Qaalat yaaa aiyuhal mala'u innee ulqiya ilaiya kitaabun kareem

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
transliteration: Innahoo min Sulaimaana wa innahoo bismil laahir Rahmaanir Raheem

arabic: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
translation: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].' "
transliteration: Allaa ta'loo 'alaiya waa toonee muslimeen

arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
translation: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
transliteration: Qaalat yaaa aiyuhal mala'u aftoonee fee amree maa kuntu qaati'atan amran hattaa tashhhaddon

arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍۢ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
translation: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
transliteration: Qaaloo nahnu uloo quwwatinw wa uloo baasin shadeed; wal amru ilaiki fanzuree maazaa taamureen

arabic: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
