translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
transliteration: Alaa yazunnu ulaaa'ika annahum mab'oosoon

arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
translation: For a tremendous Day -
transliteration: Li Yawmin 'Azeem

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
transliteration: Yawma yaqoomun naasu li Rabbil 'aalameen

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
translation: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
translation: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
transliteration: Wa maa adraaka maa Sijjeen

arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
transliteration: Kitaabum marqoom

arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
transliteration: Wailuny yawma'izil lil mukazzibeen

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
transliteration: Allazeena yukazziboona bi yawmid deen

arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
transliteration: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem

arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
transliteration: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
transliteration: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
transliteration: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
transliteration: Summa innahum lasaa lul jaheem

arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
transliteration: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafee'Illiyyeen

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa 'Illiyyoon

arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
transliteration: Kitaabum marqoom

arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
transliteration: Yashhadu hul muqarra boon

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
transliteration: Innal abraara lafee Na'eem

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation: On adorned couches, observing.
transliteration: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon

arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
transliteration: Ta'rifu fee wujoohihim nadratan na'eem

arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
transliteration: Yusqawna mir raheeqim makhtoom

arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
translation: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
transliteration: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon

arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
transliteration: Wa mizaajuhoo min Tasneem

arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
transliteration: 'Ainaiy yashrabu bihal muqarraboon

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
transliteration: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon

arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
transliteration: Wa izaa marroo bihim yataghaamazoon

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
transliteration: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
transliteration: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon

arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
translation: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
transliteration: Wa maaa ursiloo 'alaihim haafizeen

arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
transliteration: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon

arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation: On adorned couches, observing.
transliteration: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon

arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
transliteration: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation: When the sky has split [open]
transliteration: Izas samaaa'un shaqqat

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation: And when the earth has been extended
transliteration: Wa izal ardu muddat

arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
transliteration: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
translation: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
transliteration: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih

arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
translation: He will be judged with an easy account
transliteration: Fasawfa yuhaasabu hi saabai yaseeraa

arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
translation: And return to his people in happiness.
transliteration: Wa yanqalibu ilaaa ahlihee masrooraa

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
transliteration: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih

arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
translation: He will cry out for destruction
transliteration: Fasawfa yad'oo subooraa

arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
transliteration: Wa yaslaa sa'eeraa

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
transliteration: Innahoo kaana feee ahlihee masrooraa

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
transliteration: Innahoo zanna al lai yahoor

arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
translation: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
transliteration: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa

arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation: So I swear by the twilight glow
transliteration: Falaaa uqsimu bishshafaq

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation: And [by] the night and what it envelops
transliteration: Wallaili wa maa wasaq

arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
transliteration: Walqamari izat tasaq

arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
translation: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
transliteration: Latarkabunna tabaqan 'an tabaq

arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
transliteration: Famaa lahum laa yu'minoon

arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
transliteration: Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation: But those who have disbelieved deny,
transliteration: Balil lazeena kafaroo yukazziboon

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
transliteration: Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yoo'oon

arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
transliteration: Fabashshirhum bi'azaabin aleem

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation: By the sky containing great stars
transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatil burooj

arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation: And [by] the promised Day
transliteration: Wal yawmil maw'ood

arabic: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
translation: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
transliteration: Wa shaahidinw wa mashhood

arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation: Cursed were the companions of the trench
transliteration: Qutila as haabul ukhdood

arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
transliteration: Annaari zaatil waqood

arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
translation: When they were sitting near it
transliteration: Iz hum 'alaihaa qu'ood

arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
translation: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
transliteration: Wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
transliteration: Wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed

arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
translation: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
transliteration: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shaheed

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
transliteration: Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer

arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
transliteration: Inna batsha Rabbika lashadeed

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
transliteration: Innahoo Huwa yubdi'u wa yu'eed

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
transliteration: Wa Huwal Ghafoorul Wadood

arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
transliteration: Zul 'Arshil Majeed

arabic: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation: Effecter of what He intends.
transliteration: Fa' 'aalul limaa yureed

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeesul junood

arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
transliteration: Fir'awna wa Samood

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
translation: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
transliteration: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee takzeeb

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
transliteration: Wallaahu minw waraaa'ihim muheet

arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
translation: But this is an honored Qur'an
transliteration: Bal huwa Quraanum Majeed

arabic: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
transliteration: Fee Lawhim Mahfooz

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation: By the sky and the night comer -
transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wattaariq

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka mattaariq

arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation: It is the piercing star -
transliteration: Annajmus saaqib

arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
translation: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
transliteration: In kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz

arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation: So let man observe from what he was created.
transliteration: Fal yanzuril insaanu mimma khuliq

arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
translation: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
transliteration: Khuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq

arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
transliteration: Yakhruju mim bainissulbi wat taraaa'ib

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
translation: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
transliteration: Innahoo 'alaa raj'ihee laqaadir

arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
transliteration: Yawma tublas saraaa'ir

arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
translation: Then man will have no power or any helper.
transliteration: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation: By the sky which returns [rain]
transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatir raj'

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
transliteration: Wal ardi zaatis sad'

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
translation: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
transliteration: Innahoo laqawlun fasl

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation: And it is not amusement.
transliteration: Wa maa huwa bil hazl

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
translation: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
transliteration: Innahum yakeedoona kaidaa

arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
translation: But I am planning a plan.
transliteration: Wa akeedu kaidaa

arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
transliteration: Famahhilil kaafireena amhilhum ruwaidaa

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
transliteration: Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'laa

arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation: Who created and proportioned
transliteration: Allazee khalaqa fasawwaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation: And who destined and [then] guided
transliteration: Wallazee qaddara fahadaa

arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation: And who brings out the pasture
transliteration: Wallazeee akhrajal mar'aa

arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation: And [then] makes it black stubble.
transliteration: Faja'alahoo ghusaaa'an ahwaa

arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
transliteration: Sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa

arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
transliteration: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa

arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation: And We will ease you toward ease.
transliteration: Wa nu-yassiruka lilyusraa

arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
transliteration: Fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa

arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
transliteration: Sa yazzakkaru maiyakhshaa

arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation: But the wretched one will avoid it -
transliteration: Wa yatajannabuhal ashqaa

arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
transliteration: Allazee yaslan Naaral kubraa

arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation: Neither dying therein nor living.
transliteration: Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
transliteration: Qad aflaha man tazakkaa

arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
translation: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
transliteration: Wa zakaras ma Rabbihee fasallaa

arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation: But you prefer the worldly life,
transliteration: Bal tu'siroonal hayaatad dunyaa

arabic: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
translation: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
transliteration: Wal Aakhiratu khairunw wa abqaa

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
transliteration: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa

arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
translation: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
transliteration: Suhufi Ibraaheema wa Moosaa

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
translation: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeesul ghaashiyah

arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
transliteration: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin khaashi'ah

arabic: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
translation: Working [hard] and exhausted.
transliteration: 'Aamilatun naasibah

arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
translation: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
transliteration: Taslaa naaran haamiyah

arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
translation: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
transliteration: Tusqaa min 'aynin aaniyah

arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
translation: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
transliteration: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'

arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
translation: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
transliteration: Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo'

arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
translation: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
transliteration: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin naa'imah

arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
translation: With their effort [they are] satisfied
transliteration: Lisa'yihaa raadiyah

arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
translation: In an elevated garden,
transliteration: Fee jannatin 'aaliyah

arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
translation: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
transliteration: Laa tasma'u feehaa laaghiyah

arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
translation: Within it is a flowing spring.
transliteration: Feehaa 'aynun jaariyah

arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
translation: Within it are couches raised high
transliteration: Feehaa sururum marfoo'ah

arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
translation: And cups put in place
transliteration: Wa akwaabum mawdoo 'ah

arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
translation: And cushions lined up
transliteration: Wa namaariqu masfoofah

arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation: And carpets spread around.
transliteration: Wa zaraabiyyu mabsoosah

arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
transliteration: Afalaa yanzuroona ilalibili kaifa khuliqat

arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation: And at the sky - how it is raised?
transliteration: Wa ilas samaaa'i kaifa rufi'at

arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
transliteration: Wa ilal jibaali kaifa nusibat

arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
transliteration: Wa ilal ardi kaifa sutihat

arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
translation: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
transliteration: Fazakkir innama anta Muzakkir

arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation: You are not over them a controller.
transliteration: Lasta 'alaihim bimusaitir

arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
transliteration: Illaa man tawallaa wa kafar

arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
transliteration: Fa yu'azzibuhul laahul 'azaabal akbar

arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
translation: Indeed, to Us is their return.
transliteration: Innaa ilainaaa iyaabahum

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
translation: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
transliteration: Summa inna 'alainaa hisaabahum

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْفَجْرِ
translation: By the dawn
transliteration: Wal-Fajr

arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
translation: And [by] ten nights
transliteration: Wa layaalin 'ashr

arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
translation: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
transliteration: Wash shaf'i wal watr

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
translation: And [by] the night when it passes,
transliteration: Wallaili izaa yasr

arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
translation: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
transliteration: Hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
translation: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad

arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
translation: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
transliteration: Iramaa zaatil 'imaad

arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
translation: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad

arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
translation: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
transliteration: Wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad

arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
transliteration: Wa fir'awna zil awtaad

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
translation: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
transliteration: Allazeena taghaw fil bilaad

arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
translation: And increased therein the corruption.
transliteration: Fa aksaroo feehal fasaad

arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
translation: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
transliteration: Fasabba 'alaihim Rabbuka sawta 'azaab

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
transliteration: Inna Rabbaka labil mirsaad

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
transliteration: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee akraman

arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
translation: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
transliteration: Wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee ahaanan

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation: No! But you do not honor the orphan
transliteration: Kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem

arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
transliteration: Wa laa tahaaaddoona 'alaata'aamil miskeen

arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
translation: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
transliteration: Wa taakuloonat turaasa aklal lammaa

arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
translation: And you love wealth with immense love.
transliteration: Wa tuhibboonal maala hubban jammaa

arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
translation: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
transliteration: Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka

arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
translation: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
transliteration: Wa jaaa'a Rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa

arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
transliteration: Wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; Yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa

arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
transliteration: Yaqoolu yaa laitanee qaddamtu lihayaatee

arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
translation: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
transliteration: Fa Yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad

arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
translation: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
transliteration: Wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad

arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
transliteration: Yaaa ayyatuhan nafsul mutma 'innah

arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
translation: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
transliteration: Irji'eee ilaa Rabbiki raadiyatam mardiyyah

arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
translation: And enter among My [righteous] servants
transliteration: Fadkhulee fee 'ibaadee

arabic: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation: And enter My Paradise."
transliteration: Wadkhulee jannatee

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation: I swear by this city, Makkah -
transliteration: Laaa uqsimu bihaazal balad

arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
transliteration: Wa anta hillum bihaazal balad

arabic: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
transliteration: Wa waalidinw wa maa walad

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation: We have certainly created man into hardship.
transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee kabad

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
translation: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
transliteration: Ayahsabu al-lai yaqdira 'alaihi ahad

arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
translation: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
transliteration: Yaqoolu ahlaktu maalal lubadaa

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation: Does he think that no one has seen him?
transliteration: Ayahsabu al lam yarahooo ahad

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
translation: Have We not made for him two eyes?
transliteration: Alam naj'al lahoo 'aynayn

arabic: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
translation: And a tongue and two lips?
transliteration: Wa lisaananw wa shafatayn

arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
translation: And have shown him the two ways?
transliteration: Wa hadaynaahun najdayn

arabic: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
translation: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
transliteration: Falaq tahamal-'aqabah

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
translation: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka mal'aqabah

arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
translation: It is the freeing of a slave
transliteration: Fakku raqabah

arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
translation: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
transliteration: Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah

arabic: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
translation: An orphan of near relationship
transliteration: Yateeman zaa maqrabah

arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
translation: Or a needy person in misery
transliteration: Aw miskeenan zaa matrabah

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
transliteration: Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah

arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation: Those are the companions of the right.
transliteration: Ulaaa'ika As-haabul maimanah

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
transliteration: Wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah

arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation: Over them will be fire closed in.
transliteration: Alaihim naarum mu'sadah

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation: By the sun and its brightness
transliteration: Wash shamsi wa duhaa haa

arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation: And [by] the moon when it follows it
transliteration: Wal qamari izaa talaa haa

arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation: And [by] the day when it displays it
transliteration: Wannahaari izaa jallaa haa

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation: And [by] the night when it covers it
transliteration: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa haa

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wa maa banaahaa

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
transliteration: Wal ardi wa maa tahaahaa

arabic: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
transliteration: Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa

arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
transliteration: Fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation: He has succeeded who purifies it,
transliteration: Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa

arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
transliteration: Wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
transliteration: Kazzabat Samoodu bi taghwaahaaa

arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
transliteration: Izim ba'asa ashqaahaa

arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
translation: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
transliteration: Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa

arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
translation: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
transliteration: Wa laa yakhaafu'uqbaahaa

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation: By the night when it covers
transliteration: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa

arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation: And [by] the day when it appears
transliteration: Wannahaari izaa tajalla

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation: And [by] He who created the male and female,
transliteration: Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa

arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
transliteration: Inna sa'yakum lashattaa

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation: As for he who gives and fears Allah
transliteration: Fa ammaa man a'taa wattaqaa

arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation: And believes in the best [reward],
transliteration: Wa saddaqa bil husnaa

arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation: We will ease him toward ease.
transliteration: Fasanu yassiruhoo lilyusraa

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
transliteration: Wa ammaa mam bakhila wastaghnaa

arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation: And denies the best [reward],
transliteration: Wa kazzaba bil husnaa

arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation: We will ease him toward difficulty.
transliteration: Fasanu yassiruhoo lil'usraa

arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
transliteration: Wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa

arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
transliteration: Inna 'alainaa lal hudaa

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
transliteration: Wa inna lanaa lal Aakhirata wal oolaa

arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
transliteration: Fa anzartukum naaran talazzaa

arabic: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
transliteration: Laa yaslaahaaa illal ashqaa

arabic: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation: Who had denied and turned away.
transliteration: Allazee kazzaba wa tawallaa

arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation: But the righteous one will avoid it -
transliteration: Wa sa yujannnabuhal atqaa

arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
transliteration: Allazee yu'tee maalahoo yatazakkaa

arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
transliteration: Wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa

arabic: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
transliteration: Illab tighaaa'a wajhi rabbihil a 'laa

arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation: And he is going to be satisfied.
transliteration: Wa lasawfa yardaa

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation: By the morning brightness
transliteration: Wad duhaa

arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
transliteration: Wal laili iza sajaa

arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
transliteration: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa

arabic: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
transliteration: Walal-aakhiratu khairul laka minal-oola

arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
transliteration: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda

arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
transliteration: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa

arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
translation: And He found you lost and guided [you],
transliteration: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada

arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
transliteration: Wa wa jadaka 'aa-ilan fa aghnaa

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
transliteration: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
transliteration: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar

arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
transliteration: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
transliteration: Alam nashrah laka sadrak

arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation: And We removed from you your burden
transliteration: Wa wa d'ana 'anka wizrak

arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation: Which had weighed upon your back
transliteration: Allazee anqada zahrak

arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation: And raised high for you your repute.
transliteration: Wa raf 'ana laka zikrak

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
transliteration: Fa inna ma'al usri yusra

arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
translation: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
transliteration: Inna ma'al 'usri yusra

arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
transliteration: Fa iza faragh ta fansab

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
transliteration: Wa ilaa rabbika far ghab

arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation: By the fig and the olive
transliteration: Wat teeni waz zaitoon

arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation: And [by] Mount Sinai
transliteration: Wa toori sineen

arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],
transliteration: Wa haazal balad-il ameen

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem

arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
transliteration: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
transliteration: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
transliteration: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen

arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
translation: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
transliteration: Alai sal laahu bi-ahkamil haakimeen

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
transliteration: Iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation: Created man from a clinging substance.
transliteration: Khalaqal insaana min 'alaq

arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
transliteration: Iqra wa rab bukal akram

arabic: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
translation: Who taught by the pen -
transliteration: Al lazee 'allama bil qalam

arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
translation: Taught man that which he knew not.
transliteration: 'Al lamal insaana ma lam y'alam

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
translation: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
transliteration: Kallaa innal insaana layatghaa

arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
translation: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
transliteration: Ar-ra aahus taghnaa

arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
translation: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
transliteration: Innna ilaa rabbikar ruj'aa

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
translation: Have you seen the one who forbids
transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yanhaa

arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
translation: A servant when he prays?
transliteration: 'Abdan iza sallaa

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
transliteration: Ara-aita in kana 'alal hudaa

arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
translation: Or enjoins righteousness?
transliteration: Au amara bit taqwaa

arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
transliteration: Ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla

arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
translation: Does he not know that Allah sees?
transliteration: Alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa

arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
translation: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
transliteration: Kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah

arabic: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
translation: A lying, sinning forelock.
transliteration: Nasiyatin kazi batin khaatiyah

arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
translation: Then let him call his associates;
transliteration: Fal yad'u naadiyah

arabic: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation: We will call the angels of Hell.
transliteration: Sanad 'uz zabaaniyah

arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
transliteration: Kalla; la tuti'hu wasjud waqtarib

arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
transliteration: Innaa anzalnaahu fee lailatil qadr

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
transliteration: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr

arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
transliteration: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr

arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
transliteration: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr

arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
transliteration: Lam ya kunil lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena mun fak keena hattaa ta-tiya humul bayyinah

arabic: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
translation: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
transliteration: Rasoolum minal laahi yatlu suhufam mutahharah

arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
translation: Within which are correct writings.
transliteration: Feeha kutubun qaiyimah

arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
transliteration: Wa maa tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaaba il-la mim b'adi ma jaa-at humul baiyyinah

arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
transliteration: Wa maa umiroo il-la liy'abu dul laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena huna faa-a wa yuqeemus salaahta wa yu-tuz zakaata; wa zaalika deenul qaiyimah

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
transliteration: Innal lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena fee nari jahan nama khaali deena feeha; ulaa-ika hum shar rul ba reeyah

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saalihaati ula-ika hum khairul bareey yah

arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
transliteration: Jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jan naatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihal an haaru khalideena feeha abada; radiy-yallaahu 'anhum wa ra du 'an zaalika liman khashiya rabbah.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
transliteration: Izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha

arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation: And the earth discharges its burdens
transliteration: Wa akh rajatil ardu athqaalaha

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
transliteration: Wa qaalal insaanu ma laha

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation: That Day, it will report its news
transliteration: Yawmaa izin tuhad dithu akhbaaraha

arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation: Because your Lord has commanded it.
transliteration: Bi-anna rabbaka awhaa laha

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
translation: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
transliteration: Yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
transliteration: Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah

arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
translation: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
transliteration: Wa maiy-y'amal mithqala zarratin sharraiy-yarah

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
translation: By the racers, panting,
transliteration: Wal'aadi yaati dabha

arabic: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
translation: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
transliteration: Fal moori yaati qadha

arabic: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
translation: And the chargers at dawn,
transliteration: Fal mugheeraati subha

arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
translation: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
transliteration: Fa atharna bihee naq'a

arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
transliteration: Fawa satna bihee jam'a

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
translation: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
transliteration: Innal-insana lirabbihee lakanood

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
translation: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
transliteration: Wa innahu 'alaa zaalika la shaheed

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
transliteration: Wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed

arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
transliteration: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor

arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: And that within the breasts is obtained,
transliteration: Wa hussila maa fis sudoor

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation: The Striking Calamity -
transliteration: Al qaari'ah

arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation: What is the Striking Calamity?
transliteration: Mal qaariah

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
transliteration: Wa maa adraaka mal qaari'ah

arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
transliteration: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth

arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
translation: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
transliteration: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
translation: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
transliteration: Fa-amma man thaqulat mawa zeenuh

arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
translation: He will be in a pleasant life.
transliteration: Fahuwa fee 'ishatir raadiyah

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
translation: But as for one whose scales are light,
transliteration: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh

arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
translation: His refuge will be an abyss.
transliteration: Fa-ummuhu haawiyah

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
translation: And what can make you know what that is?
transliteration: Wa maa adraaka maa hiyah

arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
translation: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
transliteration: Naarun hamiyah

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
translation: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
transliteration: Al haaku mut takathur

arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
translation: Until you visit the graveyards.
transliteration: Hatta zurtumul-maqaabir

arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation: No! You are going to know.
transliteration: Kalla sawfa ta'lamoon

arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation: Then no! You are going to know.
transliteration: Thumma kalla sawfa ta'lamoon

arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
transliteration: Kalla law ta'lamoona 'ilmal yaqeen

arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
translation: You will surely see the Hellfire.
transliteration: Latara-wun nal jaheem

arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
transliteration: Thumma latara wunnaha 'ainal yaqeen

arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
transliteration: Thumma latus alunna yauma-izin 'anin na'eem

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَصْرِ
translation: By time,
transliteration: Wal' asr

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
translation: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
transliteration: Innal insaana lafee khusr

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
transliteration: Il lal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saali haati wa tawa saw bil haqqi wa tawa saw bis sabr

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
translation: Woe to every scorner and mocker
transliteration: Wai lul-li kulli hu mazatil-lumaza

arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
translation: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
transliteration: Al-lazi jama'a maalaw wa'addadah

arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
translation: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
transliteration: Yahsabu anna maalahu akhladah

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
translation: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
transliteration: Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
translation: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
transliteration: Wa maa adraaka mal-hutamah

arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
translation: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
transliteration: Narul laahil-mooqada

arabic: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
translation: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
transliteration: Al latee tat tali'u 'alalafidah

arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
translation: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
transliteration: Innaha 'alaihim moosada

arabic: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
translation: In extended columns.
transliteration: Fee 'amadim-mu mad dadah

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel

arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
translation: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
transliteration: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel

arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
transliteration: Wa arsala 'alaihim tairan abaabeel

arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
translation: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
transliteration: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel

arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation: And He made them like eaten straw.
transliteration: Faja 'alahum ka'asfim m'akool

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
transliteration: Li-ilaafi quraish

arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
transliteration: Elaafihim rihlatash shitaa-i wass saif

arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
transliteration: Fal y'abudu rabba haazal-bait

arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
transliteration: Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen

arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
transliteration: Fa zaalikal lazi yadu'ul-yateem

arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
transliteration: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen

arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation: So woe to those who pray
transliteration: Fa wai lul-lil mu salleen

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
transliteration: Al lazeena hum 'an salaatihim sahoon

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation: Those who make show [of their deeds]
transliteration: Al lazeena hum yuraa-oon

arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation: And withhold [simple] assistance.
transliteration: Wa yamna'oonal ma'oon

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
transliteration: Innaa a'taina kal kauthar

arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
transliteration: Fa salli li rabbika wanhar

arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
transliteration: Inna shani-aka huwal abtar

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
translation: Say, "O disbelievers,
transliteration: Qul yaa-ai yuhal kaafiroon

arabic: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation: I do not worship what you worship.
transliteration: Laa a'budu ma t'abudoon

arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
transliteration: Wa laa antum 'aabidoona maa a'bud

arabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
transliteration: Wa laa ana 'abidum maa 'abattum

arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
transliteration: Wa laa antum 'aabidoona ma a'bud

arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
transliteration: Lakum deenukum wa liya deen.

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
translation: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
transliteration: Iza jaa-a nas rullahi walfath

arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
translation: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
transliteration: Wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah

arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
translation: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
transliteration: Fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
translation: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
transliteration: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
translation: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
transliteration: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab

arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
translation: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
transliteration: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab

arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
translation: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
transliteration: Wam ra-atuh hamma latal-hatab

arabic: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
translation: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
transliteration: Fee jeediha hab lum mim-masad

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,
transliteration: Qul huwal laahu ahad

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
transliteration: Allah hus-samad

arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
translation: He neither begets nor is born,
transliteration: Lam yalid wa lam yoolad

arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
translation: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
transliteration: Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
transliteration: Qul a'uzoo bi rabbil-falaq

arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
translation: From the evil of that which He created
transliteration: Min sharri ma khalaq

arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
translation: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab

arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
translation: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
transliteration: Wa min sharrin-naffaa-thaati fil 'uqad

arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
transliteration: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad

arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
transliteration: Qul a'uzu birabbin naas

arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: The Sovereign of mankind.
transliteration: Malikin naas

arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: The God of mankind,
transliteration: Ilaahin naas

arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
translation: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
transliteration: Min sharril was waasil khannaas

arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
translation: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
transliteration: Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas

arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
translation: From among the jinn and mankind."
transliteration: Minal jinnati wan naas
